title: Innoweb add-ons
subtitle: Take your business to the next level with Innoweb add-ons.

payments.name: Payments
payments.description: Get paid by clients online and in-store with low cost, safe and simple payments integrated directly to your workspace.

premium-support.name: Premium Support
premium-support.description: Get the most out of the Innoweb platform and it's features with help from our experienced business support specialists.

insights.name: Insights
insights.description: Unlock additional reports and create your own unique reports which you can share with your team

google-rating-boost.name: Google Rating Boost
google-rating-boost.description: Prompt your clients to leave a Google review after they've had a positive experience and increase your footfall.

loyalty.name: Client Loyalty
loyalty.description: Encourage repeat visits and larger purchases by rewarding clients with exclusive offers that celebrate their loyalty

data-connector.name: Data Connector
data-connector.description: Connect the power of Innoweb data to your external spreadsheets, systems and other software

client-connect.name: Client Connect
client-connect.description: Keep clients close with two-way messaging and a shared inbox across web and app, all in one place

smart-website.name: Smart Website
smart-website.description: Your own professional website that updates itself as your business evolves

team-chat.name: Team Connect
team-chat.description: Give your team a dedicated space to collaborate, create group chats, and share files without leaving Innoweb

bookable-resources.name: Bookable Resources
bookable-resources.description: Manage resources like rooms and equipment. Assign them to services and track usage with detailed reports.

xero.name: Xero Accounting
xero.description: Streamline your sales and accounting with Innoweb by connecting Xero

quickbooks.name: QuickBooks Accounting
quickbooks.description: Streamline your sales and accounting with Innoweb by connecting QuickBooks

google-reserve.name: Google Reserve
google-reserve.description: Capture online bookings directly from Google Search, Google Maps and more with our Google integration.

fb-and-ig-bookings.name: Facebook and Instagram bookings
fb-and-ig-bookings.description: Add online booking to your social media pages.

meta-pixel-ads.name: Meta Pixel Ads
meta-pixel-ads.description: Use your Facebook Ads Pixel to track events, and create audiences based on their activities.

google-analytics.name: Google Analytics
google-analytics.description: Send events about certain actions to Google Analytics, and create goals based on events to track conversions

google-ads.name: Google Ads
google-ads.description: Track booking conversions from your Google Ads campaigns, optimize bidding, and retarget potential clients based on their activity.
